Usage: gebal [options] [command]

Bring-your-own-AI Solidity review harness. Source, evidence, decisions.

Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  --home <directory>             Private state directory outside assessed
                                 projects
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  doctor                         Read-only runtime and isolation checks
  init [options]                 Write a scope configuration template to an
                                 explicitly selected path
  plan [options] <repository>    Snapshot authorized local source and create a
                                 plan; does not execute checks
  review [options] <repository>  Snapshot authorized local source and create a
                                 plan; does not execute checks
  approve [options] <plan>       Approve this exact plan, including selected
                                 existing tests and any provider egress
  run [options] <plan>           Run an approved plan
  status [run]
  resume [options] <run>
  cancel <run>
  findings <run>
  decide [options] <finding>
  report [options] <run>
  evidence [options] <sha256>    Verify and inspect a content-addressed artifact
  compare <left> <right>
  context [options] <run>        Export cold, pinned source context; no cloud
                                 request or peer findings
  import-review [options] <run>  Import validated unreviewed observations from
                                 your own assistant; never executes content
  evaluation                     Run isolated source-intake and parser controls;
                                 not a security benchmark
  help [command]                 display help for command
